candidate_claims_to_test.claim: Cache miss rate increase is a consequence of export batch lag, not an independent cause of billing status unavailability.
depends_on: controlled experiment where export lag is induced
candidate_claims_to_test.why_testable: Temporal ordering in data shows cache miss rises after export lag rises; can test with higher-resolution timestamps or controlled experiments.

candidate_claims_to_test.claim: The rolled-back export batching flag was the root cause, and CHG-143 was not a contributing factor.
depends_on: availability of old batching flag configuration
candidate_claims_to_test.why_testable: Can be tested by re-applying the batching flag change in a staging environment and observing billing status behavior, while CHG-143 remains active.

candidate_claims_to_test.claim: The cache miss rate threshold beyond which billing status lookup degrades significantly is approximately 0.34.
depends_on: ability to generate cache misses artificially
candidate_claims_to_test.why_testable: Data shows 0.34 cache_miss_rate associated with 1410ms latency; can test with controlled load on support-console cache.

immutable_ground_truth.statement: On 2026-06-11T20:00:00Z pre-change baseline: cache_miss_rate=0.07, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=180, export_batch_lag_minutes=12 for support-console service.
On 2026-06-12T02:00:00Z with export retries active: cache_miss_rate=0.11, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=240, export_batch_lag_minutes=59.
On 2026-06-12T10:00:00Z with export batch b-7104 failed: cache_miss_rate=0.34, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=1410, export_batch_lag_minutes=393.
On 2026-06-12T18:00:00Z with export batch b-7105 failed: cache_miss_rate=0.39, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=1680, export_batch_lag_minutes=517.
On 2026-06-13T10:00:00Z with export batch b-7106 failed: cache_miss_rate=0.42, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=1740, export_batch_lag_minutes=603.
On 2026-06-14T02:00:00Z after rollback completed, export ok: cache_miss_rate=0.18, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=520, export_batch_lag_minutes=72.
On 2026-06-15T10:00:00Z near baseline: cache_miss_rate=0.08, billing_status_lookup_p95_ms=210, export_batch_lag_minutes=15.
The support-console change CHG-143 increased timeout tolerance but was retained after recovery.

source_summary: Synthetic support-console cache metrics showing correlation between cache miss rate, billing status lookup latency, and export batch lag over a period from June 11-15, 2026. Cache miss rate rises after export lag rises. The note states cache behavior is a symptom/amplifier, not independent root cause. CHG-143 increased timeout tolerance but retained; weaker explanation than rolled-back export batching flag.
